title: Mohammad ke Sheher me
body:
1. Kannoon mustafa ka duniya may tod ke,
Maulaa Ali vali k daaman ko chod ke -2
Kis mooh say jaa rahaa hai mohd k shaher may
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Allah nay dekho kholaa kaisa ye raaz hai,
Jis haaji per nabi ki beti naraaz hai - 2
Laanat kamaa rahaa hai mohammed k shaher me
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Dil ki yahi sadaa hai al ajal yaa imaam...
Gaibat ko apni chod k aajaaiye imaam.. - 2
Badlaaa Ali ka lengay mohammed k shaher may
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Kismat say choor hokar aayaa nabi ke paas,
khaakar rahem hussain nay rakhli hai uski laaj - 2
Rahib nay bete paaye mohamed k shaher may
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Haq fatemaa kaa khaakay soye hai aas paas,
Mahdi jo aajaengay, kholengay unkay raaz - 2
Zindaa umar  jaalaaengay mohammed k shaher may
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Jangay ohad say bhaagay they ghodo ko chod kar,
Chehre ko apne dhaap ke chaadar ko odh kar - 2
Thaktay thakkaaate aae they mohammad ke shaher may
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Dil ki hai ye tamanna majlis kare waha
Parcham uthaaye gaazi ka mehfil kare waha - 2
Maatam kare hussain ka mohammad ke sheher me
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Kya khaak jaante hai wo azmat rasool ki
Kehne ko sirf rakhte hai ulfat rasool ki - 2
Aur naate baja rahe hai mohammad ke sheher me.
